companies.Ailytics: NUS GRIP-incubated Singapore deep-tech startup. Drop unrelated companies sharing the same name.
companies.BioActivX: BLOCK71 Suzhou-listed Singapore biotech startup (incorporated 2023; Suzhou ops via NUSRI translation institute; technical lead Dr Peili Teo — NUS / Caltech postdoc with Robert H. Grubbs) building Bioactiv™ Matrix synthetic-acellular wound dressings using bioactive polymers that link oligopeptides to synthetic backbones for accelerated wound healing, reduced scarring and lower infection risk. Drop unrelated 'bioactive' wound-care marketing news unless it names BioactivX.
companies.Lapan: BLOCK71 Jakarta-resident Indonesian startup. CRITICAL: 'LAPAN' is the historic name of Indonesia's national aeronautics and space agency (Lembaga Penerbangan dan Antariksa Nasional, dissolved 2021 and folded into BRIN) — almost all 'Lapan' news refers to the space agency, not this startup. Drop unless the article explicitly references the BLOCK71 Jakarta entity (not the space agency / BRIN successor / satellite programme).
companies.LittleLives: BLOCK71 Jakarta-listed Singapore preschool SaaS (founded 2011 by Sun Ho, NUS Computing alumna) running a holistic school-management system for early-childhood centres — attendance, time-in/out, temperature/height/weight, child portfolios, log books, fees, parent communication; ~1,000 schools across Singapore, Malaysia, China, Vietnam, Cambodia; MOE/ECDA-accredited, AECES Top Preschool Software. Made strategic acquisition of Illume Technology. Drop generic 'small / little lives' branding unless it names this entity.
companies.Skuling: BLOCK71 Yogyakarta-resident Indonesian edutech startup building a gamified web learning platform — leaderboards, social discussion, performance analytics — targeting Indonesian primary/secondary education accessibility and engagement gaps. ~110,000 users across 502 of 514 Indonesian cities. Founded by Yudha Pratama Situmorang (Boston University Questrom MBA'24); 2024 Poets & Quants Most Disruptive MBA Startup. Drop generic 'schooling' / education-tech mentions.

About 6 items shown in reverse chronological order. Resolve relative item links against https://www.ailytics.ai/.

llm_fetch_required.hint: Cellivate 'Recognition' page lists press features and awards. llm_fetch_required.hint: Craft Health 'Latest News' page is a chronological press/achievements timeline organised by year and month headers (e.g. '2021', then 'January 2021'). Each entry is a bullet line of plain text describing a media mention or award, often with an inline '[<Read_More>]' or named hyperlink to an external article. Dates come from the month/year section headings, not per-item. Resolve relative links against https://www.crafthealth.me/.

llm_fetch_required.hint: WordPress (Yoast SEO) press-release page on hicuramedical.com. Each item is a row containing a publisher logo/thumbnail, a bolded headline (in <strong> tags rather than h2/h3), a short description, and a 'View Article' link to an external publisher URL. No explicit per-item date elements; dates only appear inline within some headlines (e.g. '2023'). Resolve relative links against https://hicuramedical.com/.

llm_fetch_required.hint: Card-based blog listing on insightic.io. Each card contains a thumbnail image (from /img/), a category badge ('insightic research', 'community resource', 'new partnership'), a clickable headline that links to the individual post URL, and a publication date in 'Day Mon DD YYYY' format (e.g. 'Tue Oct 31 2023') displayed below the headline.
